what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Somalia.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR and IDMC gave the same figure: 3347408 people living in internal displacement because of conflict.
Refugees from Somalia live mainly in Kenya and Ethiopia.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia in every year from 2006 to 2025, with ARS/UIC, Al-Shabaab and Hizbul Islam among the government's opponents.
UCDP also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in 2019 to 2021 and in 2025.
Drought and floods are the disasters recorded for Somalia in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figures rose from 1500000 in 2009 to a peak of 3864000 in 2022.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2018 to 2025, and new displacements from disasters were highest in 2023 in IDMC's records.

how.text: IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
The sources don't say where displaced people in Somalia are living or which routes they took.
